Master Craftsmanship

WHY CHOOSE OUR ENERGY-EFFICIENT WINDOWS

Protect your home against Sialkot’s extreme summer heat, winter cold, dust storms, and road noise with Rahman’s advanced aluminium window systems. We manufacture heavy-duty sliding windows in 75mm and 100mm profile sections equipped with double glazing (5mm tempered outer glass + 12mm dehydrated air space + 5mm inner glass). Every window is sealed with premium EPDM gaskets and fitted with anti-lift security latches and ultra-quiet nylon/brass rollers for effortless fingertip operation.

Thermal Energy Savings

Double glazing prevents summer heat transfer, drastically reducing your monthly air conditioning bills.

Street Noise Dampening

Cuts traffic and generator noise up to 70%, creating serene, peaceful bedroom and office spaces.

Dust & Rain Tight

Engineered drainage sills and perimeter wool piles block airborne dust, monsoonal rainwater, and drafts.

High Durability

Rust-free powder coating preserves vibrant finish for decades without repainting.

Frequently Asked Questions

Energy-Efficient Windows FAQs

Common questions from homeowners, builders, and business owners in Sialkot.

What is the price of double-glazed aluminium windows in Sialkot?

-

Double-glazed sliding windows typically range from Rs. 950 to Rs. 1,550 per square foot depending on glass thickness (e.g., 5mm+12A+5mm), aluminium section gauge (1.6mm heavy profile), and hardware quality.

How much street noise do double-glazed windows block?

+

Our hermetically sealed double-glazed units deliver noise attenuation up to 35-38 dB, reducing exterior traffic rumble, horns, and generator hums by more than 70%.

What warranty is offered on the glass seal and aluminium coating?

+

We provide a 5-year warranty against internal seal clouding or moisture leakage in insulated glass units, and a 10-year warranty on powder coating against weather degradation.

What materials and profile sections do you use for windows?

+

We exclusively use virgin architectural aluminium extrusion alloys (6063-T5) in 1.2mm to 2.0mm structural wall thicknesses, paired with double-bearing nylon rollers and EPDM compression gaskets.

How quickly can you survey my site for window replacement in Sialkot?

+

We offer same-day or next-day free laser measurement surveys across Sialkot, Cantt, Ugoki, and surrounding areas. Call or WhatsApp +92 302 1054485 to book.
